messages:
erin: Heads-up — we need a final decision on caps for the new Performance tier before EOD. Customers in pilot are already asking about burst behavior and contractual SLAs.

sam: Which specific limits are blocking them? burst window, sustained qps, or commitment ceilings?

erin: All three. Pilot customer wants 2x burst for first 30 days, then 1x baseline. They also want a hard cap at account level and the option to buy extra burst as an add-on.

tolga: Engineering constraints: we can safely allow 2x short bursts if we gate by prefix cache hit rate and route lower-priority traffic to a spare pool. Sustained qps above commit will cause tail latency spikes.

tolga: Proposal from infra: auto-fallback to quantized model variant when node queue > 80%, and per-customer QPS throttle that decays over 5m.

sam: From sales — customers expect explicit contract language for burst credits and an overage price. If we keep hard caps, they want rollover or buy-more option.

ance: Financial tradeoffs: giving 2x burst for free for 30 days reduces initial ARR by ~3-5% for similar pilots. But offering a paid burst add-on at 1.5x list price keeps margin. Need an explicit SKU.

erin: Can we sketch the launch rule set here? Need clear defaults and an escape hatch for large customers.

tolga: Draft rule set (suggestion):
```
quota:
  tier: Performance
  baseline_qps: 200
  burst_multiplier: 2.0 (window=30m, cooldown=60m)
  hard_account_cap: 1_000_000 tokens/day
  buy_more_addon: true
```

erin: This looks good as a starting point. Questions: 1) do we allow rollover? 2) how does this interplay with Dedicated customers?

sam: Rollover: keep simple for MVP -> no rollover, but offer purchase credit conversion. Dedicated: Dedicated customers get SLA-first routing; exclude them from these soft-burst rules unless explicitly contracted.

ance: Add-on SKU suggestion: "burst-pack-100k" priced at $X per 100k tokens with per-day cap enforcement. Will model margin after we agree.

tolga: Implementation notes: need API flags for per-route limits + telemetry tag so console can show burst usage and quota health. That increases dev work by ~3 sprint-days.

erin: Launch criteria (proposal):
- Default rule implemented and tested in staging
- Console shows per-customer burst consumption in the Usage dashboard
- Sales SKU created and basic contract language drafted
- Engineering validated fallback to quantized variant under high load

sam: For pilot customers, we'll offer a one-time free 30-day 2x burst and opt-in to purchase afterward.

erelease-bot: checklist: [ ] staging tests passed  [ ] console widgets ready  [ ] legal contract stub uploaded

erin: OK — action items: tolga to spin up staging tests for rule set (owner: tolga), nance to draft SKU and pricing targets (owner: nance), sam to notify pilot customers about opt-in flow (owner: sam). Review at 16:30 PT.

sam: noted, will ping pilot list and draft language.

tolga: starting tests now, will post logs if anything flakey.

ance: will share preliminary price bands in the doc by 15:30.

erin: thanks — short sync at 16:30 PT to finalize. :calendar:
